Recomp External Python API.short_description: Allows mods to use the Python interpreter and run Python code to interact with the native system.
Recomp External Python API.description: RecompExternalPython (also known as REPY) is a library designed to solve an persistent problem in the N64Recompiled ecosystem: the necessity of external libraries and the headaches they induce. This is accomplished by embedding a free-threaded Python runtime into an N64Recompiled mod.
